mentions.name: Self-hosted home camera monitoring (Ring alternative)
mentions.description: This self-hosted camera monitoring system replaces a Ring subscription for the cameras around the house, offering real-time monitoring with AI face recognition and interpretation of events on an internal web page, and sending alerts via Telegram.
mentions.problem: Replaces a paid Ring subscription for monitoring home cameras.
mentions.source_excerpt: Set up an in-house alternative to my Ring subscription for the cameras around my house.  So far I have it real-time monitoring, complete with AI face recognition and interpretation of events, all on an internal web page.  It also sends me alerts via Telegram.
mentions.author: diseasedyak
